correctness.rationale: The term reduction f²=f limits atomic formulas to equalities among x_i and f(x_i). Root-group decomposition gives optional root and distinct leaf blocks, exactly B_0=y and B_b=y^b(1+y)/b!. A capacity matching of sorted demands to sorted root fibers is iff feasible. Surjections from k labels to d value-blocks yield d! S(k,d), proving the polynomial spectrum. Any newly feasible diagram under nested capacities must violate a sorted inequality at index j and uses at least j(c_j+1) nonfixed values; the j-group all-leaf witness attains the minimum. Independent exact checker: 197 capacities/arity cases, 21570 tuples, and 2249 nested pairs passed. Small computations supplement—not replace—the general proof.

value.rationale: Quantifier-free definability measures elementary descriptive power for finite algebraic structures. The polynomial computes the entire parameter-free definable relation lattice size for each arity in every idempotent unary algebra; the sharp first-observable-arity index measures precisely when a capacity increase becomes expressible. Unlike a routine example or unmotivated parameter slice, these are complete natural invariants and a structural model-comparison cutoff.
